result_text:
`listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` now filters out zero-quantity rows. The SQL adds `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the other stock overviews use.

The per-product quantity lookup is a separate method, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still returns 0.

I ran `StockTest`, `StockOverviewTest`, `StockPerCategoryTest` and `SlowMovingStockTest` offline. They passed with no output, since `-q` prints nothing on success. No existing test covers `listStockByWarehouse` directly, so the change is untested beyond those runs. Nothing is committed.
